mainEntity.name: How does Flipick convert existing training materials into AI-powered videos?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flipick analyzes your documents, SOPs, and presentations and transforms them into cinematic, host-led training videos using AI narration and dynamic visuals. The process typically takes days, not weeks, and you can update a single line of content without reshooting the entire module.

mainEntity.name: Can Flipick videos be used for compliance and certification training?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Flipick supports in-video quizzes, pass/fail thresholds, and automatically issued completion certificates. The platform is SCORM and xAPI compliant, making it suitable for compliance, onboarding, and professional certification programs.

mainEntity.name: Does Flipick support multilingual training for global teams?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flipick supports voice cloning and localization into 30+ languages. You can clone a narrator's voice so no re-recording is needed, and visuals and scripts can be culturally adapted to maintain consistent brand voice across all languages.

mainEntity.name: How does Flipick personalize training videos for different roles and departments?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flipick uses AI-powered personalization to dynamically update videos based on CRM data or user inputs. Variables such as name, role, location, and department can be substituted automatically, so one master video can produce hundreds of personalized training versions.
